objects.purpose: Static event subscribers: buy-from vendor default on the header, item default on the line, header-to-line propagation and the release restriction.
Lets users maintain the vendor's Handling Class. Tooltip on the table field when the target runtime is 13.0 (BC24) or later, otherwise on the page control.
Lets users maintain the item's Handling Class. Tooltip placement as for the Vendor Card.
Lets the buyer change the order's Handling Class. ShowMandatory = true, because release enforces the value with TestField; the property is presentation only and the release check stays the guarantee.
Shows the line's Handling Class so the buyer can see the item default and the propagated value.

data-flow.note: Plain assignment in a subscriber to OnAfterCopyBuyFromVendorFieldsFromVendor, raised when Buy-from Vendor No. is validated. Handling is delivery-type data, so it follows the buy-from party, not pay-to.
Plain assignment in a subscriber to OnAfterAssignItemValues on Purchase Line, raised by CopyFromItem when No. is validated for an item.
Field is ShowMandatory on the Purchase Order page.

subscriptions.purpose: Default the header Handling Class from the buy-from vendor with a plain assignment from the Vendor record the event passes.
guards: Declare only the parameters used, with the names the publisher declares; confirm the signature in the target version's symbols.

subscriptions.purpose: Default the line Handling Class from the Item record the event passes.
guards: Use the purchase-side parameters (CurrentFieldNo, PurchHeader), not the sales-side ones; declare only the parameters used.

subscriptions.purpose: Validate Purchase Line "Handling Class" from the header when the header field changes.
guards: Act only when ChangedFieldNo = PurchHeader.FieldNo("Handling Class").
Spell the event with plural "Lines" exactly as the purchase publisher declares it.

subscriptions.purpose: Block release of a purchase order without a Handling Class: Sender.TestField("Handling Class"). The header arrives as Sender (IncludeSender). Because posting releases an open document, this also stops posting an open order outside preview.
guards: Act only when Sender."Document Type" = Order.
Raised from Release Purchase Document; not raised in posting preview or when release restrictions are skipped.
Add the check; do not take over the standard release check with IsHandled.

lifecycle.step: Give every Handling Class field added by a table extension an explicit DataClassification (table extensions inherit no table-level default) and resolve any ToBeClassified before release; decide the classification from what the field stores.

If Handling Class becomes its own table with a TableRelation (q-handling-class-type), plan it as a new business entity (table type, pages, data classification, permission set, tests) and size every referencing field with the exact type and length of the related key.

tests.given: A vendor with a Handling Class, created with LibraryPurchase
tests.when: A purchase order is created and Buy-from Vendor No. is validated to that vendor
tests.then: Purchase Header."Handling Class" equals the vendor's value

tests.given: A purchase order and an item with a Handling Class, created with library codeunits
tests.when: A purchase line of type Item is created and No. is validated to the item
tests.then: Purchase Line."Handling Class" equals the item's value

tests.given: A purchase order with several item lines
tests.when: The buyer changes Handling Class on the Purchase Order test page and confirms the line-update dialog
tests.then: Every existing line carries the new Handling Class; the ConfirmHandler is listed and executes

tests.given: A purchase order whose lines carry item Handling Class values that differ from the header
tests.when: A different header field that propagates to lines through UpdatePurchLinesByFieldNo is changed
tests.then: The lines' Handling Class values are unchanged (ChangedFieldNo guard)

tests.given: A purchase order with lines and a blank Handling Class
tests.when: The order is released through Release Purchase Document
tests.then: asserterror, then Assert.ExpectedTestFieldError for the Handling Class caption; the order stays Open

tests.given: A purchase order with lines and a Handling Class
A purchase document of another type (for example an invoice) with a blank Handling Class
An open purchase order with a blank Handling Class
tests.when: The order is posted (receive and invoice) outside preview
tests.then: Posting fails with the Handling Class TestField error and nothing is posted

tests.given: A released purchase order with a Handling Class on header and lines
tests.when: The order is received and invoiced
tests.then: Purch. Rcpt. Header/Line and Purch. Inv. Header/Line carry the same Handling Class values

tests.given: A released purchase return order with a Handling Class on header and lines
tests.then: Return Shipment Header/Line and Purch. Cr. Memo Hdr./Line carry the same Handling Class values

tests.given: A purchase order with a Handling Class on header and lines
tests.then: Purchase Header Archive and Purchase Line Archive carry the same Handling Class values

knowledge.used-for: Buy-from vendor default on the header and item default on the purchase line.
constraints: Copy the value in a subscriber with a plain assignment from the master record the event passes, never from the page.
Delivery and contact data follows the buy-from party; payment, pricing and posting data follows pay-to.
Purchase Line OnAfterAssignItemValues passes CurrentFieldNo and PurchHeader, not the sales parameters; declare only the parameters used, with the publisher's names.

knowledge.used-for: Pushing a changed header Handling Class to existing purchase lines.
constraints: Call UpdatePurchLinesByFieldNo(FieldNo(<field>), CurrFieldNo <> 0) from the header field's OnValidate.
Subscribe to OnUpdatePurchLinesByChangedFieldName (plural) and Validate the line field when ChangedFieldNo is the custom field.
Do not use ModifyAll: it skips line OnValidate, gives no confirmation and runs for code-originated changes.

knowledge.used-for: Placing the 'cannot release without Handling Class' rule.
constraints: A release rule belongs in the release restriction event of that side (OnCheckPurchaseReleaseRestrictions), which passes the header as Sender.
The release restriction event is not raised in preview or when release restrictions are skipped; posting releases an open document, so the rule also stops posting an open document outside preview.
Do not check the rule in the page action or after posting.

knowledge.used-for: Mirroring the header and line field on posted receipt, invoice, credit memo, return shipment and archive tables.
constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on Purchase Header/Line and on every target the plan needs; unless the plan excludes a document type, that means all four posted tables and the archive.
No subscriber is needed for these stages; keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables.
Do not patch posted headers in a subscriber with Modify.

knowledge.used-for: Purchase follows the same posting map as sales; tests post and read back from every target.
constraints: Decide which stages the field must reach and plan one step per stage; planning only the named tables leaves posted documents and archives blank.
Name page extensions and permission entries for new objects per stage and add a test that posts and reads the value back from every target.

Do not copy a sales subscriber to purchases without checking the purchase event's parameters; Copy Document copies posted and archived headers back with TransferFields, so decide whether that is wanted.

knowledge.used-for: Keeping the mirrored Handling Class definitions identical across the TransferFields cascade.
constraints: Define a mirrored field with the exact same field number, data type and length on every table in the cascade, at creation time.

knowledge.used-for: Conditional: applies only if Handling Class gets a TableRelation to its own table (q-handling-class-type).
constraints: For an unconditional relation, give the field the same type and exact length as the related field; read the related length from its definition rather than assuming Code[10] or Code[20].

knowledge.used-for: Conditional: applies only if Handling Class becomes a new table (q-handling-class-type).
constraints: Plan table type, numbering, setup, data rules, privacy, pages, permissions, install/upgrade and tests for a new entity; a decision the request does not settle is a question, not a default.

knowledge.used-for: Classifying the fields added by table extensions.
constraints: A tableextension inherits no table-level DataClassification; every Normal field it adds needs an explicit valid DataClassification.

knowledge.used-for: Release readiness of the new fields.
constraints: Resolve ToBeClassified to a real classification before shipping; decide from the data's content, not convenience.

knowledge.used-for: Choosing TestField for the release check.
constraints: Use TestField for a simple presence check; it adds field and record context, so do not hand-build an Error naming the field.

knowledge.used-for: Marking Handling Class mandatory on the Purchase Order page.
constraints: Set ShowMandatory = true on a visible, editable field the user must supply before an action can complete, and keep the enforcement in code; the property enforces nothing.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltip placement for the new page fields; the target runtime is unknown.
constraints: On runtime 13.0 (BC24) or later define the tooltip on the table field and omit duplicate page-level tooltips; on earlier targets put the tooltip on the page control.
Tooltip text must say what the value is used for, without inventing effects.

knowledge.used-for: Test fixtures for vendors, items and purchase documents.
constraints: Create fixtures with library codeunits (LibraryPurchase, LibraryInventory, LibraryRandom), parents first, validating foreign-key fields; do not hand-roll Init/Insert records.
[FEATURE] on the codeunit, [SCENARIO] as the first comment in each test, and [GIVEN]/[WHEN]/[THEN] marking setup, action and assertions.
Follow every asserterror with a check of the specific error; for a TestField failure use Assert.ExpectedTestFieldError.

knowledge.used-for: The header-change test that goes through the line-update confirmation.
constraints: List a handler for every UI call the scenario triggers and make each listed nonoptional handler execute; assert the semantic result, not just that the handler ran.

open-questions.question: What is Handling Class: a code that relates to a new Handling Class table (with its own page, permissions and setup), an enum, or a free code? The design assumes Code[10] without a relation.

Must Handling Class reach posted receipts, invoices, credit memos, return shipments and archives? The mirroring article requires them unless you exclude a document type; the request does not mention them.
Should a header change update all lines, or only lines of type Item? Should non-item lines get a Handling Class at all?
When a line is added after the buyer changed the header Handling Class, should the line take the item's value (as the request states) or the header's value?

When Buy-from Vendor No. changes on an order that already has lines, should the new vendor's Handling Class also be pushed to the lines? The vendor default is a plain assignment and does not run the line update.
Should the defaults and the release rule also apply to purchase quotes, invoices, credit memos, return orders and blanket orders, or only to orders?
Existing vendors, items and open purchase orders will have a blank Handling Class after installation, so open orders cannot be released until it is filled. Is a data migration or default needed?
Copy Document copies posted and archived headers back into Purchase Header. Should a copied order keep the source Handling Class or take the vendor's current value?
Should Handling Class also reach warehouse receipt lines, item ledger entries or vendor ledger entries? Not designed because the request does not ask for it.
Should posted purchase documents and archives show Handling Class on their pages?
Which object ID range and field number should be used? No repository or app.json was supplied.
